lines.text: …I was walking home from the convenience store. I saw him under the bridge. That’s all. Can I go home now?
You're shaking. Nobody here thinks you did this. What did you hear tonight?

You… really don't think it was me…? Okay. Okay, I'll tell you. It wasn't midnight when I first got there. It was earlier, around 22:50. I was on the bridge and I heard it — a tiny, high-pitched bell, ringing from under the bridge. Then someone walked away along the riverbank with a dark umbrella. I couldn't see their face… anything, really. I was so scared I hid in the bus shelter for almost an hour before I made myself go down and look. That's when I found him.
